description: Use this when the user wants to find perfumery materials by scent, family, name or CAS number, for example musks, woods or citrus to put in a formula, or the catalog name of a material they typed loosely. Returns up to 10 catalog materials (aroma chemicals, essential oils, absolutes, bases) with CAS, family, note, impact, scent facets and a page link; a material IFRA prohibits or the EU bans is marked prohibited and ranked lower. For the full detail of one material use get_material; to check a whole formula use check_formula. Not for finished perfumes or shopping advice.

query.description: A name, synonym, CAS number, family or facet, e.g. "musk".

name: search_materials
title: Search perfumery materials
